# PluginComponentAttribute

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · attribute

```csharp
public sealed class PluginComponentAttribute : Attribute
```

Describes a component: its type as written in YAML, its title and what it does. Put it on every class passed to [`IPluginBuilder`](IPluginBuilder.md). A trigger class can have several, one per event it raises.

**Example**

```csharp
[PluginComponent("acme.usb.eject", Title = "Eject a USB drive", Description = "Safely removes a USB drive.")]
[Field("drive", FieldKind.String, Description = "Drive letter, for example E:.", Required = true, KeyField = true)]
public sealed class EjectAction : IPluginAction { ... }
```

## Constructors

```csharp
public PluginComponentAttribute(string type)
```

Declares a component.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `type` | The type used in YAML: the plugin id, a dot and a name of lower-case letters, digits and underscores, for example `acme.usb.eject` for the plugin `acme.usb`. |

### OppositeEvent

```csharp
public string? OppositeEvent { get; set; }
```

For triggers: the event that undoes this one, for example `acme.usb.disconnected` for `acme.usb.connected`. A profile applied by this trigger with `revert_on: auto` is reverted when it happens.

### RunsAs

```csharp

```

For actions: where it runs. Machine actions need a plugin installed for the whole computer.

Short title in English, for example "Eject a USB drive". Required.
